fields.note: 0 none; value = min(value, max) (40 on the absorb percentages); was named Cap

statscreen.note: Median's character sheet as a table (ui/StatScreen.cpp, draw loop 0x117dc0). Decoded in docs/subsystems/stat-screen.md.

fields.name: LimitGroup
fields.note: 0 = the unique itself, else a group id: uniques of one group count together toward the limit

fields.name: LimitCount
fields.note: most items of the group the character may carry/equip; 0 = no limit (FUN_100bd0b0)

fields.name: PickDuplicates
fields.note: zero in every row, no reader found

uniqueitems2.note: Read through FUN_100be790 after checking the unit is a unique item.

fields.name: Flags
fields.note: bit 0 = Filterable: the item is listed in the loot filter's item list (D2LootFilter.cpp, FUN_100e6040 tests `*row & 1`); 471 of 476 armor, 676 of 688 weapons, 514 of 1,304 misc rows

fields.name: Classifications
fields.note: up to 16 itemclasses rows (gear, armor, tier, class, potion ...; the txt column is a comma list of their names, parser FUN_10082260 in D2Linkers.cpp), zero = unused. D2LootFilter.cpp FUN_10084df0 matches a filter rule's class against the 16 words

fields.name: InteractString
fields.note: hover text while the cursor is over the item in interact mode 0xd (FUN_1007c930); 5382 = the default text, 0 in armor2 / weapons2 (never reached: only misc items interact). 20 misc rows use string 12325 "Right click to reveal trophy challenge"

fields.name: Difficulty
fields.note: difficulty + 1 the item works in, 0 = any (item spell 16 handler 0x1007f720): 3 on 15 charged riftstones

fields.name: Infographic
fields.note: infographics help panel (infographicsnames row) the client opens on item event 13, -1 = none: sent as a 0x28-byte packet (type 0x16) by FUN_1009a9e0; only catalyst_of_disenchantment (0)

weapons2.note: armor2, weapons2 and misc2 share one layout (D2Sigma registers the same field list for the three and concatenates them: weapons2 rows, then armor2, then misc2 = the item class id, FUN_100b8010)
